title: Anthropic funds independent evaluations of AI’s effects on user wellbeing
friendlyTitle: Anthropic will fund better tests for AI and wellbeing
summary: Anthropic opened a $5 million grant programme for independent, open-source evaluations of how AI systems affect user wellbeing. Its guidance emphasises multi-turn scenarios, clinical expertise, testing both harmful compliance and excessive refusal, and validating automated graders against subject-matter experts.
friendlySummary: Anthropic is offering $5 million for independent research on how AI affects people’s wellbeing. The tests will be open source and should study long conversations, not only one answer.
whyItMatters: People increasingly use chatbots for emotional support and sensitive advice, where a single-response safety test misses changes across a conversation. Better public evaluations could help developers compare safeguards and help users understand where an assistant should not replace professional care.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI can be helpful in difficult moments, but it can also give harmful advice. Better public tests may improve safety and show where human help is needed.
